def factor_volume_price_beta_tanh(df):
    """Rolling beta of return on volume change, bounded by tanh to reduce outlier influence."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret_1 = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_1 = df_copy["volume"].pct_change()
    cov = ret_1.rolling(20, min_periods=5).cov(vol_1)
    var = vol_1.rolling(20, min_periods=5).var()
    beta = cov / var.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    beta = beta.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    bounded_beta = np.tanh(beta)
    df_copy["factor_volume_price_beta_tanh"] = bounded_beta
    return df_copy["factor_volume_price_beta_tanh"]
description: Preserves the parent's volume-price coupling beta mechanism: positive beta indicates informed flow backs price changes, negative beta signals divergence. Adds a single lightweight modifier: tanh bounding of the beta coefficient. This smooths extreme outlier beta values that can arise from near-zero volume variance, reducing their impact on Pearson IC while preserving the exact rank ordering (tanh is strictly monotonic), thereby aiming to improve ICIR without disturbing the parent's strong RankIC/RankICIR and monotonicity profile. The rolling window and min_periods remain unchanged.
